To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Polymerized grass (PG), a modified form of standard aqueous grass extracts, is less allergenic than the standard grass extract mixtures while retaining immunogenic properties.

1) PG, as compared with standard aqueous grass mixtures, has a reduced allergen content and a reduced allergenic potential while retaining immunogenic properties; 2) PG has a similar immunologic profile to standard grass extracts as measured by TRBC hemagglutinin titer and total RGGI binding; 3) PG is safe and effective for immunotherapy of grass allergic patients; and 4) PG has a lower allergenic potential and a higher immunogenic potential
polymerized grass (a modified form of grass extract) is a safe and effective immunotherapeutic agent for the treatment of allergic rhinitis due to grass pollen.
